title: Catalog Event Sources
content_data:
> **Important**
By using Catalog API endpoints, you agree to the [Product Catalog Terms](https://ads.tiktok.com/i18n/official/article?aid=6765817026859499525) and certify that you are abiding by the [TikTok Advertising Policies](https://ads.tiktok.com/help/article?aid=6685586866860720134). Please review these policies and ensure that the items you upload to your catalog don't breach them. A catalog is an asset that allows you to store information about the products you want to promote on TikTok. Using a catalog is a great solution for anyone who is looking for an efficient way to create and manage ads that feature a variety of products, like an online retailer. An event source is an app event or a website event that you bind to a catalog in a Business Center. Catalog Event Sources API enables you to bind an event source to a catalog, unbind an event source from a catalog, and get the event source binding information of a catalog. See [Overview](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1754263078057986) and [Guides](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1754263100123137) to learn about the concepts and benefits of catalogs, and to find out how to create and manage catalogs. This group consists of the following endpoints: * [Bind an event source to a catalog](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1740492491200513) * [Unbind an event source from a catalog](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1740492512449538) * [Get event source binding info of a catalog](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1740492531343362)
